React · Redux & state management

What is the difference between Context API and Redux?

Answer

  • Purpose: Context is a dependency-injection mechanism (pass values down the tree). Redux is a full state-management library.
  • Re-renders: all Context consumers re-render when the value changes; Redux useSelector re-renders only components whose selected slice changed.
  • Tooling: Redux has DevTools, time travel, middleware, logging; Context has none.
  • Async/side effects: Redux has thunks/sagas/RTK Query; Context needs your own pattern.
  • Setup: Context is built in and simple; Redux adds a dependency and structure.

Use Context for rarely changing global values (theme, auth, locale); Redux for large, frequently updated, shared business state.
